name: Jotun’s Jest
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets one item
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates (item); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You vastly enlarge a weapon or other item, which temporarily becomes suited for a Colossal creature.

The item weighs 12 its original weight and in most circumstances cannot be used effectively by creatures smaller than Gargantuan size. The item retains its normal qualities (including magical powers and effects) and returns to normal size when the spell ends.
